name: pyj
comment: pyj: Python with braces. Everything is Python (source.python, built into VS Code); this grammar only adds code blocks in { } so that statements inside them keep their Python highlighting instead of being read as a dict, and recognises `def name` / `class Name` without a trailing colon.

function-def.comment: `def name` (from the leading whitespace, so that it wins over the Python grammar's own def rule, which also starts there) — the parameters and the rest of the line are left to the Python grammar, whose own rule would wait for a ':' that pyj does not need

block.comment: Same rule as pyj itself: '{' opens a block when it follows a name, number, string, closing bracket (including the '}' of a set or dict, as in `if k in {1, 2} {`) or ':' — never after a keyword that expects an expression (return {...}, x in {...}, a and {...}, lambda: ...). Inside a block everything is pyj again, so blocks nest.
block.name: meta.block.pyj
